source: 시안 — 저장소를 만들기 전(2026-10-30) 손으로 쓴 지시문. 설계표(traits·worlds)의 바탕이 됐다
prompt:
CONCEPT: the personification of the element OGANESSON (Og) itself — the sovereign of the nation at the end of the periodic table — in THE PAST, drawn as high fantasy. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry its traits. ELEMENT TRAITS of Oganesson (Og, element 118, the last of the periodic table) to carry in her design and the scene: a synthetic superheavy element that exists for less than a millisecond — only a handful of atoms have ever been made, nobody has ever seen it. The nation at the very edge of the map: it flickers in and out of existence, its edges dissolve into light and scatter as it decays into lighter elements. By position it belongs to the noble-gas royalty (aloof, never mixing) yet is predicted to be a strange heavy solid. Palette: void black and deep indigo, pale violet-white decay glow, ghostly translucency at hems, hair and fingertips, fine fracturing light-lines, a hint of gold for royalty.
ERA — THE PAST, FANTASY: a prophesied kingdom that does not yet exist — the blank space beyond the last charted country on an ancient star-map. She stands on the final tile of a vast mosaic floor that ends in void; beyond it a half-formed ghost city flickers into being and dissolves again, towers made of violet light and falling ash. Her outfit is spectral royal regalia: a noble-gas queen's long veiled gown whose hem dissolves into drifting motes, a crown of thin fractured crystal, translucent sleeves, hair fading from indigo to transparent at the tips; an oracle's unfinished star-chart embroidered on her cloak. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.
STYLE: Polished 2.5D game key art with clean linework, controlled anime facial design, layered cel-to-soft shading and crisp costume and prop detail. Use a vivid, readable silhouette and campaign-quality lighting.
OUTPUT: one character image that works as card art. Vertical 2:3 frame, full body with head and feet inside the frame with clear margins, face turned toward the camera (front or three-quarter). Standing, card-ready pose; the environment may be rich while her design stays fully readable.
BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose or the frame.
ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no living creature, no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border.
ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, both hands drawn correctly as hands. No extra limbs.
